summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on April 29, 2026. Shareholders approved the 2025 financial statements, a US$29.9 million director and officer compensation budget, and re-appointed ten directors for two-year terms. The company also adopted a Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. This is a routine meeting notice with standard governance items and no special situation event.
